questions.question: When are you allowed to overtake a vehicle on the right?

options.text: Only when a road sign tells you to overtake
When it is safe and there are no signs or markings prohibiting it
Anytime you feel like it

questions.explanation: You may only overtake if it's safe and allowed by road signs or markings.

questions.question: After overtaking, when should you return to your original lane?

options.text: Immediately after passing the other vehicle
Once it is safe and you are well clear of the vehicle
After overtaking three cars

questions.explanation: You must make sure there is enough space before moving back to your lane.

questions.question: Should you overtake when your visibility is limited, like near a blind bend or blind rise?

options.text: Yes, if you are in a hurry
Only if you use your hooter (horn)
No, you must not overtake

questions.explanation: If you can't see clearly, overtaking is extremely dangerous.

questions.question: Can you overtake a vehicle stopped at a pedestrian crossing?

options.text: Yes, if you think no one is crossing
No, you must not overtake
Yes, but only slowly

questions.explanation: There could be pedestrians crossing that you can't see.

questions.question: What must you do when passing a stationary bus?

options.text: Drive as fast as possible past it
Look out for passengers getting on or off
Hoot to warn the bus

questions.explanation: Passengers might walk unexpectedly onto the road, so you must be alert.

questions.question: When is it allowed to overtake on the left?

options.text: If the vehicle ahead is turning right or if there are two or more lanes moving in the same direction
When you are angry
Whenever there’s no oncoming traffic

questions.explanation: These are the only times overtaking on the left is allowed legally.

questions.question: What is the safest rule to remember for overtaking?

options.text: Keep right, pass left
Keep left, pass right
Overtake whenever you want

questions.explanation: It’s always safest to stay in the left lane and overtake using the right lane.

questions.question: Can you cross over the yellow line to overtake on the left?

options.text: Yes, if there’s enough space
No, you must never cross the yellow line
Only at night

questions.explanation: Crossing the yellow line to overtake is illegal and unsafe.

questions.question: What should you do when another driver wants to overtake you?

options.text: Move to the left if safe and keep your speed steady
Speed up to prevent them from overtaking
Swerve side to side to block them

questions.explanation: You must not block or race them, help them pass safely.

questions.question: Can you overtake across a solid white line?

options.text: Yes, if you are quick
No, you must never overtake across a solid white line
Only if the car in front is very slow

questions.explanation: A solid white line means overtaking is illegal and dangerous, it’s there to protect you from crashes.
